title: Swiipt Publish Manifest
description: Immutable contract consumed by the publisher (Standard v1 section 20). The publisher never infers missing product information and refuses publication if any required gate is not PASS. This manifest is generated only at READY_TO_PUBLISH; it is a build artifact, not a working document.

publish_target.description: Only WordPress exists today; the enum grows deliberately when a new bridge is built.

product.description: PLATFORM PRODUCT PROJECTION the publisher creates (matches harness/publisher-contract.md and swiipt-core publisher.php). This is NOT the full canonical product record - that lives in data/products/<ID>/product.json. The manifest carries only the flat platform view, so the canonical records stay the single source of truth.

base_price_usd.description: Numeric price ALWAYS in USD base (lesson #17); never a converted local amount.

transformation.description: PLATFORM TRANSFORMATION PROJECTION the publisher creates (matches publisher-contract.md). The canonical transformation record lives in data/transformations/<TR>.json.

assets.description: Materialised assets the publisher creates (job is auto-mapped to a platform asset format). content is the authored markdown inlined from content/*.md. Declared assets that do not exist on disk are a deterministic BLOCKER.

commerce.description: Snapshot of product.commerce at publish time: price, currency_rules, offer, access_rules, upsells, bundles.

relationships.description: Ecosystem wiring the publisher creates (section 23): situation links, journey edges, exclusions. Matches publisher.php, which reads situation_ids / weight / next_transformation_ids; the transformation identity comes from the transformation block + product_id, so transformation_id/library_id are optional here.

situation_ids.description: swiipt_situation posts to link via swiipt_situation_transformations.

excluded_product_ids.description: Products deliberately NOT attached because they solve the same situation nucleus (section 23, anti-artificial-upsell rule).

seo.description: Truthful-only structured data inputs: title, description, schema type set. Fabricated review/rating data is forbidden by platform policy.

content.description: Product Content Factory artifacts inlined so the publisher is self-contained (Standard v1 section 20 predates the content factory; landings/product page/faq/reviews). The publisher consumes content.landing_page/product_page/faq/reviews.

access.description: Entitlement rules handed to the platform's access layer (digital_access_records / subscriptions semantics already live in swiipt-core).

download_formats.description: Formats to attach as Woo downloads - matches the delivery engine's instance kinds.

qa.description: Section 20: all five QA verdicts must be PASS. Any non-PASS means the manifest must never have been generated - the publisher additionally refuses if it sees anything else.

publish_authorization.description: Human authority record (section 21): automation eliminates labour, not governance. The authorizing human is named in every manifest.

authorized_by.description: The human (owner) who cleared Gate 10. The builder cannot self-approve.

generation.description: Writing / Generation Control (Writing Control Layer V1 section 34/35): the writing_control_version used to generate this product and a reference to the detailed execution record. Optional in pre-control manifests.

manifest.description: Path to copy/generation-manifest.json in the product record.
